_note: A get/set binding on a DOM element (`bind:clientWidth={null, set}`) is an attribute of the element, as svelte2tsx writes every get/set binding but `bind:this`: `"bind:clientWidth": get_set_binding(get, set)`, one-way names included. The element's attribute type checks the setter, so a setter taking `number | undefined` is fine and a `string` setter is a type error on the binding's key. Checking the setter against the bare DOM property type (`satisfies HTMLElement['clientWidth']`) rejected the wider setter and put the error on the setter.
